about.heroSub: One team — web, branding, and ad campaigns — run by people who've actually done the work, not just billed for it.
about.originPhotoAlt: Doulve's founders behind the scenes on set
about.originHeading: Built On Experience That Comes Straight From The Field.
about.originLede: Doulve didn't start in a boardroom — it started behind a camera and inside an ad manager.
about.originBody1: Before Doulve existed, its founders had already spent years shooting content and running ad campaigns for other people's brands — freelance, agency-side, wherever the work was. Along the way, we learned what actually moves the needle for a business, and what's just billable busywork.
about.originBody2: Doulve exists because most small and mid-sized businesses get stuck choosing between agencies priced for enterprise budgets, or freelancers who can only hand you one piece of the puzzle. We built the thing we wished existed: one team, real production experience, and pricing that assumes you're an actual small business — not a Fortune 500 subsidiary.
about.diffEyebrow: Why Not Just Hire An Agency?
about.diffSub: Most agencies aren't broken on purpose. They're just built for a different kind of client than you.
about.diffRow1Old: Three vendors for web, brand, and ads — none of them talking to each other.
about.diffRow1New: One team across web, branding, and ads — one conversation, not three.
about.diffRow2Old: Pricing built for enterprise marketing budgets.
about.diffRow2New: Pricing built for real small-to-mid-size budgets.
about.diffRow3Old: Weeks of back-and-forth for a single revision.
about.diffRow4New: Bold creative built from scratch, every time.
about.processSub: No 40-page discovery decks. No disappearing for six weeks. Here's what actually happens.
about.process1Desc: A real conversation about your business, your goals, and your budget — not a questionnaire.
about.process2Desc: Website, brand, and ad creative built in parallel, shared as it comes together — not hidden until "done."
about.process3Desc: Site, brand, and campaigns go live together, not staggered over months.
about.process4Desc: Ongoing optimization and reporting you can actually understand — no jargon required.
about.founderHeading: One Team. One Point Of Contact. Every Time.
about.founderQuote: "We spent years making other people's campaigns work. Doulve is what happens when that experience gets pointed at your business instead of someone else's."
